final_answer:
The two trains meet at approximately **11:42 and 51 seconds**. 

**Step-by-Step Explanation:**

1. **Head Start Calculation:**  
   The first train departs Station A at 9:00 AM and travels at 60 mph. By 10:00 AM (1 hour later), it has covered:  
   $$
   60 \, \text{mph} \times 1 \, \text{hour} = 60 \, \text{miles}.
   $$  
   This reduces the initial 300-mile distance between the stations to:  
   $$
   300 \, \text{miles} - 60 \, \text{miles} = 240 \, \text{miles}.
   $$

2. **Relative Speed:**  
   After 10:00 AM, both trains are moving toward each other. Their combined speed is:  
   $$
   60 \, \text{mph} + 80 \, \text{mph} = 140 \, \text{mph}.
   $$

3. **Time to Meet After 10:00 AM:**  
   Using the formula $ \text{time} = \frac{\text{distance}}{\text{speed}} $:  
   $$
   t = \frac{240 \, \text{miles}}{140 \, \text{mph}} = \frac{12}{7} \, \text{hours} \approx 1.714 \, \text{hours}.
   $$  
   Converting $ 0.714 \, \text{hours} $ to minutes:  
   $$
   0.714 \times 60 \approx 42.857 \, \text{minutes} \approx 42 \, \text{minutes and } 51 \, \text{seconds}.
   $$

4. **Final Meeting Time:**  
   Adding $ 1 \, \text{hour} \, 42 \, \text{minutes} \, 51 \, \text{seconds} $ to 10:00 AM:  
   $$
   10:00 \, \text{AM} + 1 \, \text{hour} \, 42 \, \text{minutes} \, 51 \, \text{seconds} = 11:42:51 \, \text{AM}.
   $$

**Answer:** The trains meet at **approximately 11:42 and 51 seconds**.
